description: T18 real-provider READ-ONLY verification on the release-candidate image: a restricted runtime token (non-empty grants) executes github.get_current_user against the real GitHub API through the pinned runtime; ungranted action and ungranted alias are denied pre-execution. No provider write, no message to any contact, no fabricated evidence (coordinator ruling 2).

Direct curl through the VPN returned 200, proving real GitHub reachability.
